name: explike
expr: [nL_basic, av_basic] = explike(2, x); [nL_cens, av_cens] = explike(2, x, cens); [nL_freq, av_freq] = explike(2, x, [], freq); [nL_both, av_both] = explike(2, x, cens, freq); nL_neg = explike(-1, x); nL_zero = explike(0, x); nL_empty = explike(2, []);
comment: Sig: [nL, avar] = explike(mu, x[, cens, freq]). NLL for Exp(mu). avar (scalar) = 1/I where I = Σ w_i ∂²nL_i/∂μ² (uncens: -1/μ²+2x/μ³; right-cens: 2x/μ³). Edge: mu<=0 => NaN; empty data => 0.
